by Emily Kaprinski

Overview

  • Data is from the Rhode Island Department of Health

  • Only looked at data from the year 2018

  • Used a sample size of 1000 due to large dataset size

Parts 1 and 2

1. Total Hospital Admissions by Month

  • Shows the patient admissions per month

2. Hospital Admissions between Males and Females

  • compared patient admissions by sex and month

3. Teenage Female Admissions by Month

  • shows the amount of female teenager admissions per month

  • interested because there are some months that do have zero

4. Distribution of Age by Male and Female

  • comparing the differences in the mean ages by sex

  • males have a higher average

5. Average Age of Admitted Patients by Month

  • average age per month

  • y axis is from 47 - 56 to show more variation

6. Length of Stay

  • shows the distribution of the length of stay

  • typically has some outliers, skewed to the right

7. Average Length of Stay by Season

  • using the seasons variables we created in part 1 to see the difference in los

8. Charges vs Length of Stay

  • shows the differences in cost based on los

9. Age vs Charges

  • shows the differences in cost based on age (not much difference)

10. Hospital Admission by Admission Type

  • shows the different types of admissions and how many patients were admitted per type
